title: System tray
description: Shows the small icons of background apps, like Discord, Steam or Bluetooth.

icon-size.label: Icon size
icon-size.doc: Defines the size of the tray icons.
icon-size.description: How big the tray icons are.

show-passive-items.label: Show idle apps
show-passive-items.doc: Defines visibility of the tray icons with Passive status.
show-passive-items.description: Also show icons of apps that say they don't need attention right now.

tooltip.label: Show tooltips
tooltip.doc: Option to disable tooltips on the tray icons.
tooltip.description: Show the app's popup when the mouse is over its icon.

smooth-scrolling-threshold.label: Scroll sensitivity
smooth-scrolling-threshold.doc: Threshold to be used when scrolling.
smooth-scrolling-threshold.description: How far you must scroll on a touchpad before something happens. Higher means less sensitive.

spacing.label: Space between icons
spacing.doc: Defines the spacing between the tray icons.
spacing.description: Defines the spacing between the tray icons.

reverse-direction.label: Add new icons first
reverse-direction.doc: Defines if new app icons should be added in a reverse order
reverse-direction.description: New icons appear at the start instead of the end.

on-update.label: On every refresh run
on-update.doc: Command to execute when the module is updated.
on-update.description: A command to run each time the module updates.

expand.label: Fill empty space
expand.doc: Enables this module to consume all left over space dynamically.
expand.description: Stretch the module to use all the free space left in its section.

icons.label: Custom icons
icons.doc: Per-application icon customization. Keys are application IDs (e.g., "spotify", "blueman"). A key containing ** or ? is a shell-style wildcard pattern matched against the whole ID, which suits apps whose ID changes on every launch (e.g., "dropbox-client-"). An exact key takes priority over a pattern. Values can be: - string: Custom icon name or path to icon file - false: Hide this application's tray icon completely
icons.description: Replace the icon of specific apps. Use the app's ID as the name.

orders.label: Icon order
orders.doc: Orders for items to be placed in tray. When not set, orders are controlled by DBus. Key: name of item. Value: integer, higher value means to place this item to the right.
orders.description: Choose where specific apps appear. Lower numbers come first.

ignore-list.label: Hidden apps
ignore-list.doc: List of strings used to hide matching tray items. An item is hidden when any string in the list is found (as a substring) in the item's bus name, category, icon name, id or title.
ignore-list.description: Apps whose icon should never be shown.
